events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and agree access
events.decision: Will the team have access to channel data and leadership interviews from week 1?
agenda: Present the diagnostic objective and the 22-week plan
Discuss the data and people the first weeks need
Confirm access to channel data and leadership time

events.label: Check-in: expectations
events.decision: Which leadership expectations should guide how the channel gaps are ranked?
agenda: Present the summary of CEO and Head of Digital expectations
Review progress on the channel performance baseline
Decide which expectations guide the gap ranking

events.label: Research focus
events.purpose: Choose the gaps the research takes forward
events.decision: Which channel gaps should the customer and competitor research take forward?
agenda: Present the performance baseline and the ranked gap list
Review leadership expectations against the gaps
Decide which gaps the research takes forward

events.label: Check-in: customer needs
events.decision: Which customer pain points should the peer bank benchmark focus on?
agenda: Present customer needs and pain points for all segments
Review the findings for segments 1-2 and segment 3
Decide which pain points the benchmark covers

events.label: Design focus
events.purpose: Choose the evidence the options build on
events.decision: Which customer needs and peer practices should the strategy options build on?
agenda: Present the peer benchmark and the ranked needs and practices
Review customer needs for all three segments
Decide which needs and practices the options build on

events.label: Workshop: option comparison
events.purpose: Compare options before roadmap is drafted
events.decision: Which strategic option should be detailed in the strategy and roadmap?
agenda: Present the strategic option set and its criteria
Review each option against the agreed criteria
Decide which option the strategy and roadmap detail

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Approve the digital channels strategy and roadmap as the final result?
agenda: Present the final readout of the strategy and roadmap
Review the draft roadmap against the option taken forward
Decide whether to approve the strategy and roadmap
